body.purpose: Prompts and copy in the platform face.

shadows.name: paper-on-print
shadows.purpose: Plates, choices, cartouche floating on the print.

shadows.name: seal-rest
shadows.purpose: Seal; follows its rough mask edge.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: All transitions; stamp, print cross-fade (1.2s filter, 1.6s next print), press (.15-.22s).

motion.name: stamp
motion.purpose: The 良 mark landing on a right answer.

components.name: Seal
components.description: The one primary action per screen. Use .seal.done for the completed state.
components.css: .ds-seal { position: relative; width: 7.5rem; height: 7.5rem; border: 0; background: #b23a2a; color: #f6efe3; font-family: 'Hiragino Mincho ProN','Noto Serif JP',serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; transform: rotate(-3deg); border-radius: 2px; filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 14px #0006); cursor: pointer; transition: transform .22s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), filter .22s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-seal::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 9px; border: 1.5px solid #f6efe3aa; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-seal b { font-size: 3rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; } .ds-seal span { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .3em; padding-left: .3em; } .ds-seal:active { transform: rotate(-3deg) translateY(3px) scale(.96); filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 4px #0006); } .ds-seal:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2b4c7e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Plate
components.description: Paper surface for any text on the print.
components.css: .ds-plate { background: #f1ece2; color: #1c1a17; border-radius: 3px; padding: 16px 20px; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px -6px #0006; font-family: -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif; }

components.name: Cartouche
components.description: Vertical station title with vermilion double rule.
components.css: .ds-cartouche { writing-mode: vertical-rl; display: inline-flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; background: #f1ece2; color: #1c1a17; padding: 14px 9px; border: 1.5px solid #b23a2a; outline: 1px solid #b23a2a; outline-offset: -5px; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px -6px #0006; } .ds-cartouche b { font-family: 'Hiragino Mincho ProN','Noto Serif JP',serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.9rem; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-cartouche small { font-size: .75rem; letter-spacing: .04em; color: #4f4942; font-family: -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif; }

components.name: Review Card
components.description: One monumental kana and a prompt on paper.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #f1ece2; color: #1c1a17; border-radius: 3px; padding: 28px 20px 20px; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px -6px #0006; } .ds-kana { font-family: 'Hiragino Mincho ProN','Noto Serif JP',serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 7rem; line-height: 1.05; } .ds-card p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: #4f4942; font-family: -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif; }

components.name: Choice
components.description: Answer button; add right on the correct one (stamped 良), wrong on a missed pick.
components.css: .ds-choice { position: relative; min-width: 140px; min-height: 64px; background: #f1ece2; color: #1c1a17; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; font: 600 1.4rem -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px -6px #0006; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-choice:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2b4c7e; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-right { color: #a8321f; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #a8321f, 0 8px 22px -6px #0006; } .ds-right::after { content: '良'; position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 6px; width: 26px; height: 26px; line-height: 23px; font: 800 .85rem 'Hiragino Mincho ProN','Noto Serif JP',serif; color: #a8321f; border: 2px solid #a8321f; border-radius: 50%; transform: rotate(10deg); }

components.name: Friends Row
components.description: Small plates with streak and name; .lead turns the number vermilion text.
components.css: .ds-friends { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-fp { flex: 1; text-align: center; font: .8rem -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif; padding: 8px 4px; background: #f1ece2; color: #1c1a17; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px -6px #0006; } .ds-fp b { display: block; font-family: 'Hiragino Mincho ProN','Noto Serif JP',serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.15rem; } .ds-fp.lead b { color: #a8321f; }

components.name: Progress
components.description: Session progress segments on a plate; done segments are seal red.
components.css: .ds-progress { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 10px 12px; background: #f1ece2; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px -6px #0006; } .ds-progress i { flex: 1; height: 4px; border-radius: 1px; background: rgba(28,26,23,.18); } .ds-progress i.d { background: #b23a2a; }

components.name: Nav (Android)
components.description: Material-style bottom bar on paper-2; the iOS variant is a translucent blurred tab bar.
components.html: TodayJourney
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-around; height: 80px; background: #e6dfd1; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding-top: 12px; text-decoration: none; color: #4f4942; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav .ind { width: 64px; height: 32px; border-radius: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-nav a[aria-current] { color: #1c1a17; } .ds-nav a[aria-current] .ind { background: color-mix(in srgb, #2b4c7e 28%, #e6dfd1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2b4c7e; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The current station's Hiroshige print (Hoeido Tokaido, public domain) is the app's ground, full bleed behind every screen. The interface lives on it the way the print's own furniture does: a vertical title cartouche with a thin vermilion rule, washi-paper plates, and a single red hanko seal. It refuses the study-app default of white cards, progress rings and a green Continue button.

The print is alive. Its colour follows mastery (ink sketch toward full colour), its sky band is sampled into a tint that drives the OS controls, and during review it recedes (blurred, dimmed) so one huge kana can stand on paper. Chrome is platform-adaptive: iOS conventions on iPhone, Material 3 on Android, switched in CSS by html.ios / html.android, around one shared identity. Light and dark follow the phone; in dark the paper darkens and the print dims.
keyCharacteristics: Every word sits on paper; the print never carries bare text.
One seal per screen, and it is the primary action.
Paper is cut, not rounded (3px corners), with soft ambient shadows only.
Mincho for kana and station names, platform face for everything else.
Colour is rationed: paper, ink, one vermilion, and a tint borrowed from the print.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Every word sits on paper. Text placed directly on the print is wrong, whatever the contrast.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Vermilion fills belong to the seal, cartouche rule and progress bars; vermilion text is --seal-text; tinted text is --tint-text.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Kana and station names are var(--mincho); everything else is var(--ui). No third face.

rules.name: The Paper On Print Rule
rules.body: Paper floats on the print with one soft shadow; stacking plates on plates is not needed.

dos: Do put every word on a paper surface (.plate, .choice, .cartouche, dialog).
Do give each screen exactly one .seal as its primary action.
Do set kana and station names in var(--mincho) and all other text in var(--ui).
Do use --seal-text for red text and --tint-text for tint-derived text.
Do tune each print's focus so the seal and cartouche stay off faces.
Do use stage({recede:true}) on session screens and pass sketch from progress.
Do keep tap targets at --tap or larger and honour safe-area insets.
Do leave motion on --ease (cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)); reduced motion collapses all transitions.
donts: Don't place text on the bare print.
Don't use a second primary button, white cards, progress rings, or a green Continue.
Don't use --seal or raw --tint as text colour.
Don't add a third typeface or reach for system display faces for kana.
Don't draw one nav for both platforms; use the html.ios / html.android rules.
Don't copy the current build's carried defects: tiny nav and friend-name labels (0.6875 to 0.8rem), and the duplicated .friends b font rule in index.html.
